input: Map out a sensory-friendly travel kit for my child

gold.taskTitle: Build a Sensory-Friendly Travel Kit for Your Child
gold.taskDescription: Map out the contents and organization of a sensory-friendly travel kit tailored to your child's specific needs for trips.

questions.title: What sensory sensitivities does your child have?
questions.description: Understanding whether the child is sensitive to sound, light, touch, smell, or other sensory input will shape every item selected for the kit.

questions.title: How old is your child right now?
questions.description: Age affects the size, complexity, and type of sensory tools that are appropriate and safe to include.

questions.title: What type of travel is this kit for?
questions.description: Whether the trip involves a plane, car, train, or another mode of transport changes what items are most practical and necessary.

questions.title: How long are the trips this kit needs to cover?
questions.description: A short car ride requires a very different kit from a long-haul international flight or a multi-day road trip.

questions.title: Does your child already use specific comfort items or tools?
questions.description: Knowing what already works, such as a weighted lap pad, chew necklace, or specific fidget toy, ensures proven items are included.

questions.title: Are there any dietary or allergy considerations for snacks?
questions.description: Sensory kits often include preferred snacks as a calming tool, so food allergies or texture preferences are important to factor in.

questions.title: What is your budget for assembling this kit?
questions.description: Budget determines whether recommendations lean toward DIY solutions, everyday household items, or specialized sensory products.
